project.name: osgi/domains/doctor/doctor-contract-test
project.description: The -test fragment of doctor-contract: a Fragment-Host attached to the doctor-contract bundle, sharing its classloader so its test classes run IN-CONTAINER against the record vocabulary's own world. It carries, in src/main so they land in the fragment: (1) the value-type tests (ProblemRef, SchemaRef, Referral, ClinicianId, Provenance, InterventionLedger, ResolutionPredicate, Checkpoint, Patient, Assessment, MedicalRecord, ConsultationReport expectations, efficacy) — they test doctor-contract types, so they live with them, not on a port; (2) the shared model fixtures (ReferralReplies, FakeSpecialist, TestReferrals) in package io.nxmatic.rke2lab.doctor.testkit, EXPORTED so sibling test fragments (doctor-core-test) and domain -core tests (cluster/systemd/netplan) import them through the doctor-contract host (OSGi Core §3.14). It REPLACES the dissolved doctor-contract-test as the testkit exporter — doctor-contract is gone (de-seamed: its two interfaces folded into doctor-core). The src/test harness is plain JVM (VSCode-clickable): boots Felix, attaches this fragment, proxies each @Test into the container.
